title: Rapid Clustering + MVP Scoping Playbook for Enterprise Feature Requests
creator: Linnea Park
description: Create a fast, repeatable playbook that lets Sales and Customer Success aggregate incoming enterprise feature requests and produce a defensible minimum-viable scope (MVS) and implementation rough-order estimate within 5 business days. This ticket defines the clustering heuristics, the lightweight priority scorecard, the handoff artifact template, and an experimental automation sketch (Sheets + BigQuery + Linear tags) to reduce manual triage time. Goal: reduce time-to-first-scope from ~12 days to <=5 days for high-value requests and surface clear engineering/UX signals for PM prioritization.
success_metrics: Median time from sales submission to first-scope <= 5 business days
% of high-revenue accounts with scoping in first pass >= 90%
Reduction in PM triage backlog by 30% within quarter
acceptance_criteria: Documented playbook in Confluence with examples for 4 request archetypes
Working clustering spreadsheet (proto) that assigns each incoming request to a cluster and priority score
Two trial handoffs completed with Sales and Eng and feedback documented
PM sign-off on MVS template and priority scorecard
priority_score_components: Support burden delta (0-3); final bucket: High/Medium/Low
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Opted for a lightweight scorecard vs full RICE model to keep CS adoption high; tradeoff: lower numerical granularity but higher throughput
Initial automation will surface clusters and suggested scores; final scores remain human-validated to avoid overtrusting heuristics
MVP scope template will intentionally avoid technical implementation details — those are deferred to ENG scoping spike to keep first-pass cadence fast
